text: How many steps are in the standard troubleshooting model covered in this module?
explanation: The standard model has 8 steps, though some versions group the first four into one step, giving 5 or 6 steps.

text: What is the FIRST step in the 8-step troubleshooting model?

options.text: Identify the symptoms of the problem

explanation: Step 1 is to identify the symptoms. You must understand what the problem looks like before you can investigate further.

text: At what point in the troubleshooting process should documentation take place?

options.text: Only at the end once the problem is solved

explanation: Documentation must happen throughout the process, not just at the end. Step 8 of the model specifically covers documenting everything.

text: Which step comes immediately AFTER implementing the solution?
explanation: Step 5 is implement, Step 6 is test. You must always verify the solution actually works before closing the fault.

text: What are the four high-level stages of the troubleshooting process?

options.text: Investigate, Plan & Implement, Document, Review & Evaluate

explanation: At a high level the process breaks into: investigate the problem, plan and implement a solution, document the steps taken, then review and evaluate.

text: Why is documentation especially important when multiple technicians work on the same system?

options.text: Without it, a technician would have to trace everything from scratch
It speeds up the hardware repair
It replaces the need for testing

explanation: Without documentation, even an experienced technician on an unfamiliar system would have no starting point and would need to trace everything point-by-point from scratch.

text: Which step involves checking what has recently changed on the system?
explanation: Step 3 is 'Identify any recently-applied changes'. Recent changes are often the cause of new faults.

text: What does Step 7 of the 8-step model involve?

options.text: Analysing the possible effects of the solution

explanation: Step 7 is to analyse the possible effects of the solution — making sure your fix hasn't introduced new problems elsewhere.

text: Why might some versions of the troubleshooting model show only 5 or 6 steps?

options.text: They group steps 1-4 together as 'Identify the problem'

explanation: Some versions group steps 1-4 together as simply 'Identify the problem'. The core idea is the same regardless of how the steps are grouped.

text: Which of the following best describes Step 4 of the 8-step model?

options.text: Identify the most likely source of the problem

explanation: Step 4 is 'Identify the most likely source of the problem' — using the information gathered in steps 1-3 to form a diagnosis.
